name: Coolify
author: coollabsio
description: Self-hosted PaaS — push a repo, get a running app, from a dashboard on this box. Four containers (Coolify, Postgres, Redis, Soketi) with the dashboard on :8101 because OpenHands already owns Coolify's upstream :8000. Loopback-only behind Serve. The first admin is seeded from .env so /register is never an open 'whoever loads the page first is root' window. Coolify's Traefik proxy is off: upstream binds :80/:443 on every interface, which would put this box on the LAN. Apps you deploy through it should publish a loopback port and get their own tailscale serve. In-app auto-update is off too — it rewrites compose and would undo those binds. Upgrade by bumping COOLIFY_VERSION in .env and re-running setup.sh.

control._comment: Stop order: the dashboard first, then Soketi, then Redis, then Postgres. Start is the reverse.
